comparison.objective: Spot a scripted bench presser, intervening only when a rep stalls; candidate commissions a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed human-motion monitoring, bar capture, and assisted lifting versus small-tool alignment, fine rotary tuning, counterholding, locking, and machine cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Avoid early interference, catch the sixth stalled rep before the chest, and assist to lockout; candidate requires two quantified safe stopping cycles and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Reactive load assistance and timing around a person are separate from tuning and mechanically locking an energy absorber.
